d: What is chirality in chemistry? In this video, we explain chirality in simple words — from why your left and right hands are mirror images that can't overlap, to how molecules with the same atoms can behave completely differently depending on their 3D arrangement. Learn about enantiomers, stereoisomers, the plane of symmetry test, and why chirality matters in real life — from the thalidomide tragedy to why oranges and lemons smell different despite having the same molecule.
